database.roQuestion: Create a read-only user for Databasus?
database.roExplainSuffix: user with limited permissions that can only read data from your database, not modify it. This is recommended for backup operations because:
database.roBulletPrevent: it prevents accidental data modifications during backup
database.roBulletLeast: it follows the principle of least privilege
database.roSecuritySuffix: ). However, it is not possible to be covered from all possible risks.
database.roCoreMessage: Read-only user allows to avoid storing credentials with write access at all
database.roCoreSuffix: . Even in the worst case of hacking, nobody will be able to corrupt your data.
database.roHasWrite: Current user has the following write {{label}}:
database.roSkipConfirm: Are you sure you want to skip creating a read-only user?
database.roSkipExplain: Using a user with full permissions for backups is not recommended and may pose security risks. Databasus is highly recommending you to not skip this step.
database.roSkipAdvice: 100% protection is never possible. It's better to be safe in case of 0.01% risk of full hacking. So it is better to follow the secure way with read-only user.
database.roContinueSecure: Let's continue with the secure way
